name: Calendar streak
what: A month card pops in and its days fill one after another with coloured dots, a streak counter ticking with them - a habit, a posting plan, a countdown to a date.

learned_from.what: a month card whose days fill with coloured dots one by one
a month whose dates appear one by one

motion: card back.out 14 f; a day every 3 f (back.out 8 f), the counter ticks; a kick when it ends
